readout.notes: Client reads option-letter logprobs from vLLM /v1/completions (logprobs=20, prompt_logprobs fallback). Requires a runtime that returns completion logprobs for the letter tokens. llama.cpp and MLX not verified. Installer image recipe uses source-reviewed BH native Gemma4 letter-logit readout at T=1; no vLLM endpoint approximation.
readout.portable_notes: No portable unmodified backend established. Author readout/vllm_scoring.py L139–141 uses standard logprobs first, but L155–163 falls back to vLLM prompt_logprobs for missing candidate labels. That fallback is necessary for a full option distribution; therefore backend_agnostic=false. https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shisa-ai/jevbench-results/ae4bdf4e7ab9f5216c541c1bf30bef520ee7fb1f/readout/vllm_scoring.py. No author CPU/MPS server or same-author GGUF/MLX readout found at the pinned revisions. BF16 weights are 51.612 GB despite only 4B active parameters.

variants.expected_speed: Not measured for this installer recipe. Historical published benchmark timings describe a separate runtime.
variants.notes: 51.6 GB BF16 weights in 2 shards; ROSTER estimate ~53 GB + <1 GB activations (min 53). Recommended 80 GB for a single card with KV headroom at 8192 context (derived). The author's TP2 run reported 129 GB per GPU reserved by vLLM, which is a vLLM reservation, not a requirement. Host RAM provisioning estimate: pinned weight files sum to 51.612 GB; ×1.25 loader/runtime allowance rounded up to 4 GB gives 68 GB. This is not a measured peak; FP32 initialization or duplicate weight buffers may require more. Installer recipe is source-derived and unverified; this executable runtime was not benchmarked. See catalog/IMAGE-RECIPES-V2.md for modifications and dependency provenance.
